Question 14
?

Consider the straight line that passes through P(3,−2,3) and is parallel to v=⟨−2,1,2⟩. Find all the possible points A on that line such that AP=3.

a
A1(1,1,−5) and A2(5,3,2)
b
A1(1,−1,5) and A2(5,−3,1)
c
A1(1,−1,−5) and A2(5,3,2)
d
A1(1,2,5) and A2(−5,3,1)
e
A1(−1,−1,5) and A2(4,−3,−1)
Submit
